jaFieldProjection.titleJa: 軟腐病（キャベツ）の掲載例に対応する外観図
jaFieldProjection.altJa: 緑の外葉に囲まれたキャベツの結球部に、褐色に変色して欠けた葉の部分があり、その内側の淡い色の結球部が見えるイラスト。
jaFieldProjection.observationJa: 変色した部分の位置と広がり、葉の欠けや崩れた輪郭、露出した淡い結球部を合わせて見ます。褐色だけで判断せず、周囲の葉や実際の発生状況も確認します。
jaFieldProjection.limitJa: 資料の掲載名に対応する外観の一例です。他の腐敗や傷みと似る場合があり、この図だけで軟腐病と確定できません。軟らかさ、臭い、原因菌は画像から確認できず、防除・農薬の選択や食べられるかどうかの判断にも使いません。

findings: Source page viewed during this batch shows brown damaged outer tissue and exposed pale rounded head in the soft-rot-captioned cabbage example. New art retains these visible features and green outer leaves, with no clean dissection face.

Compared with the separate sclerotinia illustration, this image emphasizes larger missing/disrupted outer tissue and broader exposed pale head, rather than merely changing brown color. These are differences between selected illustrations, not a reliable distinction between diseases.

All4JAfields correctly describe visible localization, missing tissue/irregular outline and pale head. Limit explicitly states overlap with other decay, no definitive diagnosis, and no softness/odor/pathogen inference from the drawing; no pesticide/treatment/edibility decision.
